name: Media Studio
tagline: Generate short videos and narration via Anna's host media services — async jobs, progress, cancel, persist.
description: Media Studio is the reference App for the platform media generation surface (forum #373/#358): text-to-video and image-to-video as async jobs with live progress and cancel/refund, synchronous TTS narration, capability discovery with CU pricing, URL-expiry recovery, and persisting artifacts to host storage. It also bundles the clip-narrator executa demonstrating the plugin-side reverse RPC half (video/generate + audio/speak).
